product_metadata.title: Ayesha Curry Home Collection Nonstick Cookware Pots and Pans Set, 9 Piece, Sienna Red
features: COOK LIKE AYESHA CURRY: Essential cookware set for home chefs who emulate Ayesha Curry's signature style of simplicity and fearless fun

ESSENTIAL POTS AND PANS: 9-piece cookware set is crafted from durable aluminum for fast and even heating, includes two covered saucepans (1.5-qt / 2-qt), one 5.5-qt covered Dutch oven, one 8.5-Inch Skillet, and one 12-Inch Covered Skillet
CRANK UP THE HEAT: Double-riveted stainless steel handles are oven safe to 500 degrees F, shatter-resistant glass lids seal in heat and moisture
STOVE TOP STYLE: Crafted with stylish hard enamel porcelain exteriors and enhanced, diamond-textured, PFOA-free nonstick interiors for long-lasting food release
COOKWARE WITH A CAUSE: This Ayesha Curry kitchenware helps support No Kid Hungry to provide up to 500,000 meals to children in need.
